# ProgressRing

Header: `winui/ui/status/ProgressRing.hpp`. Spec: `winui/ui/status/ProgressRing.hpp`.

Circular progress, by default an indeterminate spinner.

Indeterminate (the default), a three-quarter arc rotates continuously. Determinate, an accent arc sweeps clockwise from the top over the fraction of [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)] that [`value()`](#value) has reached. The ring is 32 DIPs across by default (at least 16) with a 4 DIP stroke, and draws no track unless a [`background()`](#background) is set. `set_active(false)` hides it entirely. It takes no input and has no disabled state. [`ui::ProgressRing`](#uiprogressring) is the declarative form.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> working{true};

window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::ProgressRing{.active = working, .width = 32.0f},
        ui::Button{.text = "Stop", .on_click = [&] { working = false; }},
    },
});

// A determinate gauge with a visible track:
auto ring = std::make_unique<ui::ProgressRingControl>(/*value=*/40.0);
ring->set_indeterminate(false);
ring->set_background(ui::Color::from_argb(0x33808080));
ring->set_value(75.0);
```

## `ui::ProgressRing`

The circular counterpart of [ui::ProgressBar](progress-bar.md#uiprogressbar). Builds a [ui::ProgressRingControl](#uiprogressringcontrol).

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> working{false};

window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing  = 8,
    .content  = {
        ui::ProgressRing{.active = working, .width = 32.0f, .height = 32.0f},
        ui::ProgressRing{.value = 70.0, .width = 32.0f, .height = 32.0f},
        ui::ToggleSwitch{.header = "Working"},
    },
});
```

```cpp

    .value, .min, .max, .active, .background, .style, .margin, .width, .height, .min_width,
    .min_height, .max_width, .max_height, .horizontal_alignment, .vertical_alignment, .visible,
    .tool_tip, .accessibility, .on_value_changed, .on_pointer_entered, .on_pointer_exited,
    .on_got_focus, .on_lost_focus, .on_key_down, .on_wheel, .control
}
```

## `ui::ProgressRingControl`

Derives from `ui::Element`, `ui::RangeValueProvider`.

Circular progress, by default an indeterminate spinner.

Indeterminate (the default), a three-quarter arc rotates continuously. Determinate, an accent arc sweeps clockwise from the top over the fraction of [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)] that [`value()`](#value) has reached. The ring is 32 DIPs across by default (at least 16) with a 4 DIP stroke, and draws no track unless a [`background()`](#background) is set. `set_active(false)` hides it entirely. It takes no input and has no disabled state. [`ui::ProgressRing`](#uiprogressring) is the declarative form.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<bool> working{true};

window.set_content(ui::HorizontalStack{
    .spacing  = 12,
    .content  = {
        ui::ProgressRing{.active = working, .width = 32.0f},
        ui::Button{.text = "Stop", .on_click = [&] { working = false; }},
    },
});

// A determinate gauge with a visible track:
auto ring = std::make_unique<ui::ProgressRingControl>(/*value=*/40.0);
```

### ProgressRingControl

```cpp
ProgressRingControl(double value = 0.0, double min = 0.0, double max = 100.0)
```

An active, indeterminate ring; [`max`](#max) below [`min`](#min) is raised to [`min`](#min) and [`value`](#value) is clamped into the range. Sets a 16x16 DIP minimum size.

### min

```cpp
double min() const
```

The value with no arc; 0 by default.

### max

```cpp
double max() const
```

The value drawing the full circle; 100 by default.

### set_range

```cpp
void set_range(double min, double max)
```

Sets both ends ([`max`](#max) below [`min`](#min) becomes [`min`](#min)) and re-clamps [`value()`](#value), firing [`on_value_changed()`](#on_value_changed) if that moves it. Always marks the ring for redraw.

### value

```cpp
double value() const
```

The value, always within [[`min()`](#min), [`max()`](#max)]; 0 by default. Drawn only while determinate.

### set_value

```cpp
void set_value(double value)
```

Clamps into the range. Does nothing, and fires no callback, when the clamped value is unchanged. Otherwise redraws and fires [`on_value_changed()`](#on_value_changed).

### is_indeterminate

```cpp
bool is_indeterminate() const
```

Whether it spins endlessly instead of showing a share; true by default.

### set_indeterminate

```cpp
void set_indeterminate(bool indeterminate)
```

Turning it on restarts the rotation from the top. Marks the ring for redraw.

### is_active

```cpp
bool is_active() const
```

Whether the ring shows; true by default. An inactive ring draws nothing but keeps its layout size.

### set_active

```cpp
void set_active(bool active)
```

Shows or hides the ring. Redraws only.

### background

```cpp
const std::optional<Color>& background() const
```

The fixed fill of the track circle. nullopt (the default) draws no track, unless a theme resource is set.

### background_resource

```cpp
ThemeColor background_resource() const
```

The track fill as a theme resource, or nullptr.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(std::optional<Color> background)
```

Sets the fixed track fill and clears a theme-resource one. Marks the ring for redraw when the color changes.

### set_background

```cpp
void set_background(ThemeColor resource)
```

Sets the track fill to a theme resource, re-read under every theme, and clears a fixed one.

### on_value_changed

```cpp
void on_value_changed(Callback<void(double)> handler)
```

Fired with the new, clamped value whenever [`value()`](#value) changes. Replaces any previous handler.

### parallel_measure_safe

```cpp
bool parallel_measure_safe() const override
```

True: measuring reads nothing shared.

### automation_role

```cpp
AutomationRole automation_role() const override
```

[ProgressBar](progress-bar.md#uiprogressbar), with a range value that UI Automation can read but not set.

### measure_override

```cpp
Size measure_override(Size available, const MeasureContext& context) const override
```

32 x 32 DIPs, capped at a bounded `available` size.

### render_override

```cpp
void render_override(Renderer& renderer, const RenderContext& context) const override
```

Draws the optional background circle, then the arc as one stroked path with round ends.

### tick_override

```cpp
void tick_override(Duration delta) override
```

Advances the indeterminate arc's rotation (a 1.5 s turn) and redraws while active and indeterminate. Ignored otherwise, and while the arc is animated without redrawing.
